content: HTML5 Canvas performance degrades with many draw calls, state changes, sub-pixel coordinates, and per-frame full clears. Best practices include offscreen caching for repeated tiles, integer coordinates, layered canvases, avoiding shadowBlur/text rendering, CSS transforms for scaling, requestAnimationFrame, and alpha:false for opaque backgrounds. For a Mahjong board with ~150 tiles, GPU-backed rendering (WebGL or engine like Phaser/PixiJS) and sprite atlases are preferred over raw 2D canvas; particle effects should be toggleable for low-end devices.
